title: "Start here"

## Run it without building anything

The `wxy` command and the Python and R packages are published as
container images (see [wxylib/images](https://github.com/wxylib/images)).
None of them contain GDAL or PROJ: everything is pure Rust.

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures

# warp a COG to Antarctic polar stereographic, written as GeoZarr
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/data ghcr.io/wxylib/wxy \
  warp fixtures/cog/world-int16-deflate.tif out.zarr \
  --crs EPSG:3031 --extent -4e6 -4e6 4e6 4e6 --size 145 145 -r bilinear

# values at lon/lat points, x,y lines on stdin (note -i)
printf '147.3,-42.9\n-70.6,-33.4\n' |
  docker run --rm -i -v "$PWD":/data ghcr.io/wxylib/wxy \
  points fixtures/cog/world-int16-deflate.tif

# the plan as JSON: every chunk it would fetch, reading no data
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/data ghcr.io/wxylib/wxy \
  warp fixtures/cog/world-int16-deflate.tif out.zarr \
  --crs EPSG:3031 --extent -4e6 -4e6 4e6 4e6 --size 145 145 --dry-run
```

## Build from source

```sh
git clone https://github.com/wxylib/core
git clone https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures
cd core
cargo test --workspace
cargo run -p wxy-cli -- warp ../fixtures/cog/world-int16-deflate.tif out.zarr \
  --crs EPSG:3031 --extent -4e6 -4e6 4e6 4e6 --size 145 145
```

The tests find the fixtures at `../fixtures` (or `WXY_FIXTURES`) and skip
when they are missing.

## From R or Python

Both packages are early spikes that warp in-memory arrays only. Install
from source as their READMEs describe ([R](https://github.com/wxylib/r),
[Python](https://github.com/wxylib/py)), or use the `ghcr.io/wxylib/wxy-r`
and `ghcr.io/wxylib/wxy-py` images.

```r
library(wxy)
z <- outer(seq(89.5, -89.5), seq(-179.5, 179.5), function(lat, lon) lat)
w <- wxy_warp(z, c(-180, 180, -90, 90), "EPSG:4326",
              dst_extent = c(-5e6, 5e6, -5e6, 5e6), dst_dim = c(200, 200),
              dst_crs = "+proj=stere +lat_0=-90 +lat_ts=-71 +datum=WGS84",
              resample = "bilinear")
```

- The [OISST walk-through](oisst-virtual.md) reads a month of real sea

  against GDAL, and warps a day to the Antarctic.
- The [capability map](capabilities.qmd) says what works on which kind of
  grid, and through which way in.
